item.title: Core Keeper Pixel Art Tool — Convert Images to Pixel Art Online
item.description: Turn any picture into a Core Keeper pixel art blueprint. Upload an image, choose your grid size, and this pixel art tool converts it into a blocky pixel canvas with an automatic color palette — ideal for planning in-game pixel murals, billboards and farm layouts, and it runs entirely in your browser. Upload any image and convert it into a blocky pixel-art canvas — perfect for planning in-game pixel builds (billboards, farms, pixel murals).
